description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Spellblade] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Dualcast Spellblade 1] and [Quick Cast 1]/[Attach Earth], [Dualcast Spellblade 2] and [Quick Cast 2]/[Attach Earth with Stacking], [Dualcast Spellblade 3] and [Quick Cast 3] to the user if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF5 allies are alive

description.name: Awoken Spellblade
description.text: Spellblade abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
